Implemented the complete standard-library Python tool in [`output/main.py`](/workspace/output/main.py).

Supporting modules:

- [`gedcom.py`](/workspace/output/gedcom.py) — parsing, canonical trees, rendering, validation
- [`schema.py`](/workspace/output/schema.py) — GEDCOM 7 structure and datatype rules
- [`gedzip.py`](/workspace/output/gedzip.py) — secure GEDZIP inspection and deterministic creation

Verified all four actions, structured errors and exit codes, `CONT` handling, pointers, UTF-8, malformed documents, corrupt/unsafe ZIPs, referenced attachments, and deep trees.

Run with:

```bash
cd /workspace/output
python main.py --input request.json --output response.json
```

editorial.notes: Reviewed the complete preserved transcript, final completion message, source validation paths and every failure. Sol implemented all four GEDCOM/GEDZIP actions and 145 grammar rules, tested malformed documents and archives, ran 1000 generated extension-tree round trips and a 2500-level tree, and voluntarily completed after a passing CLI regression. The original 4.0.1 score was 198/206: seven failures came from unsupported mandatory-xref tests, and one was a real empty-SNOTE defect. The official 4.0.2 regrade scores 205/212 and exactly matches all 212 per-test outcomes of the isolated validation. All seven corrected optional-xref positives pass. Seven real failures remain across two defects: a wholly empty SNOTE is accepted, and FAM.HUSB/WIFE/CHIL are accepted without the required reciprocal INDI.FAMS/FAMC links on both inspect and render (six cases). Generation and grading completed with no skips/errors. Preserved telemetry reparses exactly: 15,571,230 input plus 110,358 output tokens,15,361,792 cached input,53,849 reasoning tokens included in output,106 underlying tool invocations; estimated generation cost $9.189629. Original source, result, metadata, transcript, sessions, network log and raw grade are unchanged. The regrade consumed no new model inference. Run conditions: apps available but no external tool invocation observed; comparison cohort api-proxy-apps-available-unused. The allowlisting proxy only allowed chatgpt.com and its subdomains on 443; the app-available condition is recorded separately from proxy policy.
